008package paint.generatesquares.calc;
009
010import paint.shared.config.GenerateSquaresConfig;
011import paint.shared.objects.Experiment;
012import paint.shared.objects.Recording;
013import paint.shared.objects.Square;
014import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
015
016import java.io.IOException;
017import java.nio.file.Path;
018import java.util.List;
019
020/**
021 * Pure, in-memory square-generation computation for a single recording.
022 *
023 * <p>Operates on a loaded {@link Recording} (with its tracks) and mutates it in
024 * place with the generated squares and their computed attributes. It performs no
025 * experiment loading and writes no output files — those I/O steps stay in the
026 * orchestrator ({@code GenerateSquaresProcessor.generateSquaresForExperiment}),
027 * so this computation can be exercised directly in tests.</p>
028 *
029 * <p>The only side outputs reachable from here are optional and off by default:
030 * a debug CSV (enabled by the {@code Debug} flag) and plot PNGs (enabled by the
031 * plot flags); {@code experimentPath} is used only for the latter.</p>
032 */
033public final class SquareGenerationService {
034
035    private SquareGenerationService() {
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * Runs the full per-recording computation: grid generation, track assignment,
040     * and square-level and recording-level attribute calculation. The recording
041     * is mutated in place.
042     *
043     * @param recording      the loaded recording (with its tracks)
044     * @param config         the generate-squares configuration
045     * @param experimentPath experiment directory, used only for optional plot output
046     * @return {@code true} if the computation completed; {@code false} if the
047     *         thread was interrupted mid-computation (before attribute calculation)
048     * @throws IOException only if optional debug output is enabled and fails
049     */
050    public static boolean computeRecording(Recording recording,
051                                           GenerateSquaresConfig config,
052                                           Path experimentPath) throws IOException {
053
054        // Create the squares with basic geometric information.
055        List<Square> squares = GenerateSquaresProcessor.generateSquaresForRecording(recording, config);
056        recording.setSquaresOfRecording(squares);
057
058        // Assign the recording's tracks to the squares.
059        GenerateSquaresProcessor.assignTracksToSquares(recording, config);
060
061        // Cancellation point mid-computation (preserved from the original loop).
062        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
063            return false;
064        }
065
066        // Calculate square-level and recording-level attributes.
067        CalculateSquareAttributes.calculateSquareAttributes(experimentPath, recording, config);
068        CalculateSquareAttributes.calculateRecordingAttributes(recording, config);
069        return true;
070    }
071
072    /**
073     * Runs the computation for a whole loaded experiment: every recording flagged for
074     * processing is computed in place, and the selection parameters actually used are then
075     * stamped onto every recording so they travel with the output.
076     * <p>
077     * This reads nothing and writes nothing. The caller loads the {@link Experiment} and, if
078     * this returns {@code true}, writes the results — which keeps the pipeline a plain
079     * load → compute → write and lets the whole computation be exercised in a test without a
080     * project directory to write into.
081     *
082     * @param experiment     the loaded experiment (recordings with their tracks)
083     * @param config         the generate-squares configuration
084     * @param experimentPath experiment directory, used only for optional plot output
085     * @return {@code true} if the computation completed; {@code false} if it was cancelled
086     * @throws IOException only if optional debug output is enabled and fails
087     */
088    public static boolean computeExperiment(Experiment experiment,
089                                            GenerateSquaresConfig config,
090                                            Path experimentPath) throws IOException {
091
092        for (Recording recording : experiment.getRecordings()) {
093
094            if (!recording.isProcessFlagSet()) {
095                continue;
096            }
097
098            if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
099                PaintLogger.infof("Cancelled before processing recording %s",
100                                  recording.getRecordingName());
101                return false;
102            }
103
104            PaintLogger.infof("   Processing: %s", recording.getRecordingName());
105            PaintLogger.debugf(recording.toString());
106
107            if (!computeRecording(recording, config, experimentPath)) {
108                PaintLogger.infof("Cancelled before attribute calculation for %s",
109                                  recording.getRecordingName());
110                return false;
111            }
112        }
113
114        // Record the selection parameters that were applied, on every recording — so the
115        // written output states the thresholds it was produced under.
116        for (Recording recording : experiment.getRecordings()) {
117            recording.setMinRequiredRSquared(config.getMinRequiredRSquared());
118            recording.setMaxAllowableVariability(config.getMaxAllowableVariability());
119            recording.setMinRequiredDensityRatio(config.getMinRequiredDensityRatio());
120            recording.setNeighbourMode(config.getNeighbourMode());
121        }
122
123        return true;
124    }
125}
